rows.current: Converts 3D ROI lists to a label image. Depending on the number of objects, an 8-bit, 16-bit, or 32-bit label image is generated. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Convert IJ3D ROI to RGB

rows.current: Generates a results table containing 3D ROI statistics. If a reference image is provided, the statistics are calculated for the reference image. Otherwise, NaN is returned. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Extract IJ3D ROI statistics

rows.current: Updates every 3D ROI in a list of 3D ROIs by optionally setting its name, comment, center coordinates, channel, frame, and fill color, then outputs the updated list.
rows.name: Set IJ3D ROI properties

rows.current: Extracts all pairwise statistics between the 3D ROI This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Extract pairwise IJ3D ROI statistics

rows.current: Turns a grayscale label image, where each object is marked, into a list of 3D ROIs. It detects separate marked objects, applies optional size, sphericity, and edge filters, and uses image calibration when available.
rows.name: IJ3D Labels to 3D ROI

rows.current: Filters the 3D ROI lists by testing for mutual overlap. The ROI1 output contains all ROI1 input ROI that overlap with any of ROI2. The ROI2 output contains all ROI2 input ROI that overlap with a ROI1 ROI. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Filter IJ3D ROI by overlap (old)

rows.current: Finds 3D particles in a binary mask image and returns them as a list of 3D ROIs. It labels connected components, applies optional size, sphericity, edge, and background settings, and uses image calibration for physical measurements when available.
rows.name: IJ3D Find particles 3D

rows.current: Keeps 3D ROIs that meet a condition based on their measured statistics. It takes a list of 3D ROIs and an optional reference image, calculates the selected measurements, and outputs the matching 3D ROIs as a new list. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Filter IJ3D ROI by statistics

rows.current: Takes a list of 3D ROIs and an optional reference image, then creates a greyscale mask image marking the 3D pixels covered by the ROIs. The mask matches the reference image size when one is supplied; otherwise it is sized to the ROIs. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: IJ3D ROI to mask

rows.current: Converts the ROI into bounding boxes, convex hulls, etc.
rows.name: Outline IJ3D ROI

rows.current: Colors a list of 3D ROIs by a chosen measurement. It takes 3D ROIs and an optional reference image, measures the selected statistic for each ROI (in physical units when available), maps the values to a color map, and outputs the same 3D ROI list with updated fill colors. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Color IJ3D ROI by statistics

rows.current: Converts 3D ROI lists to a label image. Depending on the number of objects, an 8-bit, 16-bit, or 32-bit label image is generated. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: IJ3D ROI to labels

rows.current: Splits the 3D ROI lists into individual 3D ROI lists.
rows.name: Split into individual IJ3D ROI lists

rows.current: The 3D Watershed operation works with two images, one containing the seeds of the objects, that can be obtained from local maxima (see 3D filters), the other image containing signal data. A first threshold1 is used for seeds (only seeds with value > threshold1 will be used). A second threshold is used to cluster voxels with values > threshold2. In this implementation voxels are clustered to seeds in descending order of voxel values. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: IJ3D Watershed 3D segmentation

rows.current: Extracts the metadata (properties map) of each 3D ROI and writes them into a table
rows.name: Extract IJ3D ROI metadata as table

rows.current: Allows to filter/remove specific ROI metadata entries
rows.name: Remove/Filter IJ3D ROI metadata

rows.current: Deprecated. Please use the new node. Exports a 3D ROI list into one or multiple ROI files This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Export IJ3D ROI

rows.current: Exports a 3D ROI list into one or multiple ROI files This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Export IJ3D ROI

rows.current: The Voronoi algorithm will draw lines between objects at equal distances from the boundaries of the different objects, then compute zones around objects based on these lines. This can also be seen as the splitting of the background. Neighbouring objects can then be computed as objects having a line in common.
rows.name: IJ3D Voronoi 3D

rows.current: The main application of watershed in ImageJ is the 2D splitting of merged objects. This splitting is based on the computation of the Distance Map inside the mask of the merged objects. The seeds are then the local maxima of the distance map, the farthest points from the boundaries, hence corresponding to the centres of the objects. The bigger the object, the higher the values of the distance map at the centre, then the faster the growing of the seeds and the larger the resulting object. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: IJ3D Watershed 3D splitting

rows.current: 3D Canny-Deriche edge detection filter. Will compute the gradients of the image based on the Canny edge detector.
rows.name: IJ3D 3D edge filter

rows.current: Detects local maxima with high contrast. Local maxima in a specified radius are computed and sorted by intensity. Starting from local maximum with highest intensity, a 3D flooding is performed, all connected pixels with values above the value of (LocalMaxima - NoiseValue) are marked as zone of the local maximum. All other local maxima from these zones are removed. The next local maximum is processed, this step is repeated until there are no more local maxima to process. The final image is created with local maxima, with their original intensity value.
rows.name: IJ3D 3D maxima finder

rows.current: Compute the gradients of the image based on the Canny edge detector. Then the symmetry filter will vote for the voxels inside the object based on the gradient vector direction.
rows.name: IJ3D 3D symmetry filter

rows.current: Applies the 3D adaptive smoothing filter (similar to the Nagao filter) using an ellipsoidal neighbourhood.
rows.name: IJ3D Fast 3D adaptive smoothing filter

rows.current: Calculates the morphological closing using an ellipsoidal neighbourhood.
rows.name: IJ3D Fast 3D morphological closing

rows.name: IJ3D Fast 3D local max filter
